html: † [תַּחְבֻּלָה] n.f. direction, counsel (prob. orig. of rope-pulling, i.e. steering, directing a ship, v. חֹבֵל, so Thes; v. De Pr 1:5);—only pl. and only WisdLt. תַּחְבֻּלוֹת abs. Pr 1:5 + 3 times; cstr. Pr 12:5; sf. תַּחְבּוּלֹתָ֯ו Jb 37:12—direction, guidance (i.e. by God) Jb 37:12 (of thunder cloud); counsels of wicked (רשׁעים) Pr 12:5 (opp. מַחְשְׁבוֹת צדיקים); gen. good, wise counsels Pr 1:5; 11:14 (‖ רֹב יועֵץ), 24:6 (‖ id.); 20:18 (‖ עֵצָה).
